title: Deteriorated as it aged.
text: Deteriorated as it aged.. Deteriorated over time. Cracks formed around the hole in the bottom causing fat to leak out on my counter.

product_metadata.title: Cuisipro Fat Separator, One, Clear
features: Easy drip feature separates sauce from fat easily and effectively
Sauce is released from the bottom of the fat separator and the silicone plug controls the release of sauce and fat
Made of see-through, durable, and heat resistant tritan material; bpa free
Easy to Disassemble and clean; top shelf dishwasher safe
Oversized straining separates large food particles from sauce
description: Create healthier sauces and gravies with none of the fat and all of the flavor with this Cuisipro fat separator. Made from Tritan plastic and silicone, the Cuisipro fat separator is heat resistant and durable. The oversized straining basket allows the liquid to pour in and the food pieces to be left behind for smooth sauces. A silicone stopper allows draining from the bottom so that the fat stays at the top. With a built in measurement indicator, there is no guessing how much sauce and fat there is. Easy to take apart and reassemble, this fat separator is dishwasher safe and easy to store. Promising customer satisfaction, the Cuisipro fat separator comes with a manufacturer's 25 year warranty.
6'' diameter x 9'' H, with a 4 cup capacity
